description: Senator Dan Stec was elected to serve the constituents of the 45th Senate District in 2020. His district includes all of Essex & Warren Counties, the Towns of Corinth, Day, Hadley and Edinburgh in Saratoga County and the Towns of Dresden, Fort Ann, Granville, Hampton, Hebron, Putnam and Whitehall in Washington County.
